instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the React frontend in Javascript (.js / .jsx files) inside /app/frontend/src.
Ensure dark mode is forced by applying 'dark' class to html or root container with dark background #0A0D12.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or #1B93A4 anywhere in the application.
Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font styling for all financial numbers, prices, spread percentages, timestamps, and pnl values.
Implement all 10 key functionalities specified in the prompt with high functional density and real-time feel.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, metrics, buttons, inputs, and tables as specified in key_components_breakdown.
Utilize lucide-react or @heroicons/react for crisp UI icons.

Provide full interactive controls: paper/live mode toggle, manual bot start/stop, simulation controls to trigger realistic spread opportunities, position close buttons, and config parameter adjustments.
Ensure full responsiveness across desktop and laptop viewports with dense, scanable grid layouts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid standard empty white cards or generic template centered layouts. Use a high-density tactical dark theme with crisp borders and functional color coding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Red = short/negative PnL/down spread, Green = long/positive PnL/hurdle met, Cyan = system primary/leader signal, Amber = timeout/warning, Blue = laggard status.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid on every button, input, toggle, chart container, table row, and key metric display.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions_rule: NEVER use transition: all globally. Specify transition-colors or transition-transform for buttons and cards.
